headlines.title: The Tech Selloff Is Only Strengthening My Belief In Alphabet
headlines.summary: While most investors flee the tech selloff, one mega cap keeps pulling more capital in the opposite direction, and the reasoning has nothing to do with hoping for a rebound.

headlines.title: “The Mag 7’s Market Cap Is Going to $100 Trillion. But One of Them Is Going Extinct.”
headlines.summary: One veteran hedge fund manager believes the Magnificent 7 will grow into one of the most dominant forces in financial history, yet predicts that one or two of those companies will vanish entirely before the race is over.

headlines.title: Apple Pay Crypto Hiring Fuels New Stablecoin Speculation
headlines.summary: Apple posted a U.S.-based Apple Pay Financial Product Strategy Lead role, listing a base-pay range of $149,700 to $280,000 and listing familiarity with stablecoins, tokenized deposits, and crypto technology among its desired skills.

headlines.title: Waymo is bringing driverless taxis to a fourth country
headlines.summary: Alphabet’s robotaxi unit found a government willing to admit what most regulators only mutter.

headlines.title: What Does Alphabet (GOOGL) Face In This New AI Safety Lawsuit?
headlines.summary: Alphabet (NasdaqGS:GOOGL) unit Google DeepMind has been named in a new class-action lawsuit targeting leading AI labs. The complaint challenges an industry-funded safety oversight body that would coordinate pre-release reviews of advanced AI models. Plaintiffs allege the joint safety structure could amount to coordinated action to slow AI development and distort competition.

description: Alphabet Inc. offers various products and platforms in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, Canada, and Latin America. It operates through Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets segments. The Google Services segment provides products and services, including ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. It is also involved in the sale of apps and in-app purchases and digital content in Google Play and YouTube; and devices, as well as the provision of YouTube consumer subscription services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, NFL Sunday Ticket, and Google One. The Google Cloud segment offers consumption-based fees and subscriptions for AI solutions, including AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini enterprise. It also provides cybersecurity, and data and analytics services; Google Workspace that include cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Calendar, Gmail, Docs, Drive, and Meet; and other enterprise services. The Other Bets segment sells transportation and internet services. Alphabet Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
